title: A.R.M.O.R. observation of a camera, as the observation service reports it to the server
description: The body of POST /api/v1/ai/observations: what a service that watches a camera saw. `severity` says whether a person should look (`review`) or the service is sure enough to treat it as an intrusion (`high`); `reasons` are short sentences (at most five) for the person who reads the alarm; `profile` is the light the picture was taken in; `motion` is how sure the service is that something moved (0 to 1) and `motion_ratio`, when it is said, the share of the picture that changed (0 to 1); `regions`, when it is said, are the rectangles where it moved, in fractions of the picture (`x` and `y` the top left corner, `w` and `h` the size; at most 16, the largest first); `radar_tracks` is how many radar targets were being followed at that moment. It carries no picture. The server raises an alarm only while the system is armed.
